_about: [slurs] plainPerformance (the owner's "C", 2026-10-17): every event of a part played plain on its Performance patch goes this many ms early. Each value is the median of (heard - written) of the plain notes, measured in context: the passage played plain (abl.py's PLAINb, branch qt-bends, tools/soundlibraries/qt_bends/abl.py) through Kontakt 8 + SSO in kthost on the Windows test VM, onsets by the heard check's analysis (tools/playbackverify/heard_check.py). gen_spitfire_sso.py writes it as <Instrument plainShift>. A Performance patch not listed plays its notes as written (shift 0; the playback audit lists it).
